target.statement: EALM achieves a Samples F1 score of 44.5% on the MP-ETHICS test set, outperforming RoBERTa-base (35.7%), DeBERTa-base (37.3%), and DeBERTa3-large (38.1%).
target.dataset: MP-ETHICS (public scaled-down version: 100 train / 100 test samples)

compute.basis: MP-ETHICS is tiny (100 train / 100 test), but reproducing EALM requires implementing the cross-attention ethical reasoning module on top of DeBERTa-v3-large and fine-tuning for 20 epochs; on CPU this is slow but feasible within a couple of hours, and the paper only releases a scaled-down dataset so exact numbers may not match.

blockers: Only a scaled-down MP-ETHICS (100/100 samples) is publicly released; the full dataset is withheld, so the reported 44.5% may not be exactly reproducible.
The EALM cross-attention ethical reasoning module is described but not guaranteed to be fully implemented in the linked repo; reimplementation may be needed.
Paper reports training on a single A100 GPU; CPU-only reproduction will be slower and may need hyperparameter adjustment.
title: EALM: Introducing Multidimensional Ethical Alignment in Conversational Information Retrieval
